q1: SELECT f1.drinker, f2.drinker FROM (SELECT drinker, SUM(times_a_week) AS st FROM frequents GROUP BY drinker) AS f1, (SELECT drinker, SUM(times_a_week) AS st FROM frequents GROUP BY drinker) AS f2 WHERE f1.drinker < f2.drinker AND f1.st = f2.st
q2: WITH Drinker_Total AS (SELECT drinker, SUM(times_a_week) AS total_times FROM Frequents GROUP BY drinker) SELECT d2.drinker AS drinkerA, d2.drinker AS drinkerB FROM Drinker_Total AS d1 JOIN Drinker_Total AS d2 ON d1.total_times = d2.total_times AND d1.drinker < d2.drinker
